# Impact Fire Services Resources

> > Comprehensive fire protection, life safety, and security system resources from Impact Fire Services, covering NFPA compliance, fire suppression systems, emergency communications, and industry best practices.

Impact Fire Services provides educational content on fire protection systems, life safety equipment, security solutions, and regulatory compliance. The resource library includes technical guides on NFPA and OSHA standards, fire alarm and sprinkler systems, clean agent suppression, public safety DAS/ERRCS, and practical workplace safety guidance for commercial facilities.

## Key Topics

- NFPA Standards & Compliance
- Fire Protection Systems
- Life Safety Systems
- OSHA Compliance
- Public Safety DAS/ERRCS
- Emergency Responder Radio Communications
- Fire Sprinkler Systems
- Fire Alarm Systems
- Clean Agent Suppression
- Access Control & Security
- Building Code Compliance
- Fire Extinguisher Maintenance
- Workplace Fire Safety
- Emergency Communications

## Fire Protection Systems & Equipment

- [The Top 6 NFPA Standards You Should Know](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/top-six-nfpa-standards): Overview of essential NFPA fire safety codes and compliance standards
- [Do Fire Extinguishers Expire?](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/do-fire-extinguishers-expire): Fire extinguisher lifespan, NFPA 10 replacement schedules, and maintenance
- [3 Clean Agent Fire Suppression Systems to Protect IT Infrastructure](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/clean-agent-fire-suppression-systems-protect-it-infrastructure): Waterless fire suppression options: FM-200, Novec 1230, and Inergen systems
- [Why Vertical Fire Pumps Are Great For Space-Efficient Fire Protection](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/vertical-fire-pumps): Space-saving vertical fire pump systems for commercial fire protection
- [Why Your Facility Needs Backup Batteries for Fire Alarm Systems](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/backup-batteries-for-fire-alarm-systems): Fire alarm backup battery requirements, NFPA 72 compliance, and maintenance

## Compliance & Workplace Safety

- [Who is Responsible for Fire Safety in the Workplace?](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/who-is-responsible-for-fire-safety-in-the-workplace): Workplace fire safety responsibilities and OSHA compliance requirements
- [Why to Regularly Inspect Your Fire and Life Safety Systems](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/why-to-regularly-inspect-your-fire-and-life-safety-systems): Benefits of regular fire and life safety system inspections and maintenance
- [Building a Culture of Safety: The Critical Role of Employee Fire Training](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/employee-emergency-fire-training): Employee fire training importance, OSHA compliance, and safety culture
- [What You Should Ask Your Fire Protection Company](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/what-you-should-ask-your-fire-protection-company): Five key questions for evaluating fire protection service providers

## Emergency Communications & Public Safety DAS

- [How to Meet Building Code Requirements with a Public Safety DAS](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/how-to-meet-building-code-requirements-with-a-public-safety-das): Guide to ERRCS/Public Safety DAS building code compliance requirements

## Security Systems & Access Control

- [What is an Intrusion Alarm System?](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/intrusion-alarm-system): Intrusion alarm system components, operation, and security benefits
- [Key Warehouse Security Measures to Protect Your Facility](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/warehouse-security-measures): Warehouse security best practices including access control and fire safety
- [4 Types of Security Systems to Protect Your Small Business](https://resources.impactfireservices.com/4-types-of-security-systems-to-protect-your-small-business): Small business security systems: surveillance, alarms, and access control
